name: Hormuud Telecom Somalia
notes:
Hormuud Telecom (AS37371) is Somalia's largest network operator, serving mobile, fixed and enterprise customers nationwide.

We operate a national fibre backbone, metro networks in Mogadishu,other Cities  and cable landing stations on the PEACE and DARE-1 submarine systems. We interconnect internationally at iColo MBA1 ,SEACOM CLS Nyali in Mombasa, Kenya, Djibouti Data Center and Digital Realty Marseille MRS2.

We peer selectively for IPv4 and IPv6. Traffic is heavily inbound. On-net caching is available in Mogadishu; content networks are welcome to enquire.

Suggested maximum prefix limits:
IPv4: 200
IPv6: 100
